tasks.gr12-inventory-valuation-control-t2: Topic: Inventory Valuation and Control. Cover periodic and perpetual systems, FIFO, weighted average, lower of cost and NRV, stock deficits, and internal control over inventory. Ask Grade 12 learners to value stock, identify the effect on cost of sales or profit, or recommend stock-control improvements.
tasks.gr12-fixed-assets-analysis-control-t2: Topic: Fixed Assets: Analysis and Control. Cover carrying value, depreciation methods, disposals, asset notes, asset age and replacement ideas, and internal control over fixed assets. Ask Grade 12 learners to calculate depreciation or profit on sale, interpret asset-management information, or evaluate control weaknesses.
tasks.gr12-manufacturing-cost-statements-t2: Topic: Manufacturing Cost Statements. Cover direct materials, direct labour, factory overheads, work-in-process, cost of production, and unit cost. Ask Grade 12 learners to classify manufacturing costs, complete a production cost calculation, or interpret changes in unit cost and factory efficiency.
tasks.gr12-bank-creditors-reconciliations-t2: Topic: Bank and Creditors Reconciliations. Cover outstanding deposits, unpresented cheques, cashbook updates, supplier statements, creditors control, and reconciliation-related internal controls. Ask Grade 12 learners to identify reconciling items, update the correct record, or explain a control recommendation.
